candidate_pool_rule: in-season: prev5_minutes_sum > 0 or season_to_date_appearances > 0 before cutoff; GW1: prior_season_minutes > 0 or prior_season_appearances > 0; otherwise cold_start_no_history when no lagged or prior history exists

population_rules.all_observed_standard_players: all standard-player rows observed in the audited Phase 2 player-fixture panel
population_rules.pre_deadline_history_active: decision-relevant rows identified only from lagged history before information_cutoff
population_rules.cold_start_no_history: standard-player rows with no same-season lagged activity and no prior-season minutes or appearances
population_rules.actual_appearances_diagnostic: retrospective diagnostic subset with target player-gameweek minutes greater than zero

b6_formula: previous-season shrunk points-per-90 rate times previous-season average minutes per appearance capped at minutes_cap; no-history fallback is the training global mean
